messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and safely: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a quick wash (soft cloth, mild soap), remove dust from the fretboard, and tune it to standard pitch. | A clean, well‑tuned instrument looks more appealing and shows buyers you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Inspect & Repair** | Check for cracks, loose screws, worn strings, or other issues. Replace strings, tighten pegs, or fix minor damage yourself; otherwise consider a quick visit to a luthier. | Minor repairs can increase resale value and reduce negotiation headaches. | | **3. Take Quality Photos** | Use natural light, capture front, back, headstock, soundhole, and any unique features or blemishes. Include a reference object (e.g., a coin) for scale. | High‑quality images attract more views and set realistic expectations. | | **4. Write an Honest Description** | Mention brand, model, year, wood type, finish, condition (“excellent”), and any accessories (case, strap). Be transparent about scratches or repairs. | Honesty builds trust and reduces returns or disputes. | | **5. Research Pricing** | Look up similar models on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local music stores. Factor in age, condition, and any upgrades. | Competitive pricing speeds sales while ensuring you don’t undersell. | | **6. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Reverb** – great for musical instruments, offers seller protection.
• **eBay** – broad audience, auction or fixed price.
• **Craigslist / Facebook Marketplace** – local, no fees, but requires in‑person meetings.
• **Local Music Stores** – consignment or direct sale; they may offer a fair price for used gear. | Diversifying platforms increases exposure. | | **7. Set Up Payment & Shipping** | • For online sales, use PayPal Goods & Services or Stripe for buyer protection.
• Offer multiple shipping options (UPS Ground, USPS Priority).
• Insure the package at least $200 for high‑value guitars. | Secure payments protect against fraud; insured shipping protects both parties. | | **8. Meet Safely (if local)** | • Arrange a public meeting spot (coffee shop, library, police station).
• Bring a friend or family member if possible.
• Verify the buyer’s ID and test the guitar together. | Safety first—public places reduce risk, and having someone else present adds security. | | **9. Finalize the Sale** | • Sign a simple bill of sale (include serial number, date, price, and signatures).
• Hand over the guitar, case, strap, and any original paperwork. | A written record protects both parties legally. | | **10. Follow Up** | • Ask for a photo of the guitar in its new home (optional).
• Leave a review for the buyer if the platform allows. | Positive reviews build your reputation as a trustworthy seller. | ### Quick Tips - **Timing:** List during weekdays when people browse for weekend projects; avoid major holidays unless you’re targeting holiday shoppers. - **Negotiation:** Decide beforehand how low you’re willing to go. Stick to your minimum price to avoid “price wars.” - **Safety:** Never accept cash outside a bank or safe deposit box. If a buyer insists on cash, meet at a bank lobby where you can verify the amount. - **Shipping Prep:** Wrap the guitar in bubble wrap, place it in a hard‑sided case or padded envelope, and double‑box if shipping internationally. --- #### Example Listing (Reverb) ``` Title: 2010 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition Description: - Brand/Model: Yamaha FG800 - Year: 2010 - Wood: Spruce top, mahogany back & sides - Finish: Natural gloss - Condition: Very good – no cracks, only minor scuffs on the neck - Accessories: Original case, strap, extra strings - Notes: Recently tuned, strings replaced last month Price: $350 (fixed) Photos: [Attach 5–6 clear images] Seller Info: [Your name], verified seller, located in [City] ``` Feel free to adapt this template to your chosen platform. Good luck with your sale!
